marketing_description: The DeWALT MAX XR Series DCB2108 battery offers 50% more power for tough jobs and features a durable overmolded base for impact resistance. This 20 V, 8 Ah lithium-ion battery is compatible with DeWALT 20 V MAX tools and chargers, and includes an LED state-of-charge indicator. It provides cordless operation and a high capacity for extended runtime.
